content:
{'text': "The new Apple TV 4K has been delayed for some time, originally expected to launch last fall. However, with Siri AI finally ready, all signs point to a new Apple TV 4K debuting soon, possibly unveiled at the September 9 event. Here's what's been circulating so far.", 'translation': '新一款 Apple TV 4K 早已推遲推出，原本預計去年秋季發表。不過隨着 Siri AI 終於準備就緒，各項跡象均顯示新 Apple TV 4K 即將亮相，可能會喺 9 月 9 日嘅活動上揭曉。以下係目前流傳嘅消息。'}

{'text': '#1: Siri Remote refresh', 'translation': '#1：Siri Remote 更新'}

{'text': "While details haven't leaked just yet, Apple is reportedly planning a refreshed Siri Remote for the new Apple TV 4K.", 'translation': '雖然暫時未有細節流出，但據報 Apple 將為新 Apple TV 4K 推出更新版 Siri Remote。'}

{'text': 'Code found in a test build of macOS 26.7 seemingly confirmed the existence of the new Siri Remote. And ahead of that leak, Mark Gurman also reported that new hardware would "likely include an improved Apple TV remote."', 'translation': 'macOS 26.7 嘅一個測試版中流出嘅代碼，似乎確認咗呢款新 Siri Remote 嘅存在。而喺呢次爆料之前，Mark Gurman 都曾報導過新硬件「可能會配備改良版 Apple TV 遙控器」。'}

{'text': "It doesn't look like a major overhaul. But hopefully, at minimum, a second-generation Ultra Wideband chip will be added for Precision Finding support.", 'translation': '睇落唔似會有太大改動。但希望至少會加入第二代超寬頻晶片，以支援精確尋找（Precision Finding）功能。'}

{'text': '#2: Siri AI and more Apple Intelligence', 'translation': '#2：Siri AI 以及更多 Apple Intelligence 功能'}

{'text': 'Siri AI is expected to be a major marketing focus for the new Apple TV, and also will apply to other new home products.', 'translation': 'Siri AI 預計將會係新 Apple TV 嘅主要宣傳重點之一，同時亦會應用於其他新嘅家居產品。'}

{'text': "As of now, Apple has yet to announce whether this all-new assistant will come to the Apple TV 4K or HomePod. But there's growing evidence that tvOS 27 will include Siri AI, likely limited to the new hardware.", 'translation': '截至目前，Apple 仍未公佈呢個全新助理會否登陸 Apple TV 4K 或 HomePod。但愈來愈多證據顯示，tvOS 27 將會加入 Siri AI，而且好大機會只限於新硬件先用到。'}

{'text': 'The new Apple TV also stands a good chance at bringing other Apple Intelligence features, like an improved search experience.', 'translation': '新 Apple TV 亦相當有機會帶嚟其他 Apple Intelligence 功能，例如更強嘅搜尋體驗。'}

{'text': '#3: New A-series chip', 'translation': '#3：新 A 系晶片'}

{'text': 'The existing Apple TV uses the A15 Bionic chip, which first debuted in 2021. Fortunately, the new model will get a significant performance boost.', 'translation': '現有 Apple TV 採用嘅係 2021 年首次登場嘅 A15 Bionic 晶片。慶幸嘅係，新型號將會喺性能方面迎嚟大幅提升。'}

{'text': 'The new A-series chip will be more powerful and support various AI features.', 'translation': '新嘅 A 系晶片將會更強勁，並支援各項 AI 功能。'}

{'text': "Previous rumors suggested the new chip might be an A17 Pro or A18. But those reports largely came from before the Siri AI rollout. It wouldn't be surprising if Apple equipped the new hardware with a more powerful A19 or A20 chip.", 'translation': '之前嘅傳聞指出，新晶片可能係 A17 Pro 或 A18。但呢啲報導大多來自 Siri AI 推出之前嘅時期。如果 Apple 為新硬件配備更強嘅 A19 或 A20 晶片，都唔會令人意外。'}

{'text': '#4: N1 wireless chip', 'translation': '#4：N1 無線晶片'}

{'text': 'The N1 wireless chip, which debuted in the iPhone 17, is also rumored to come to the new Apple TV 4K.', 'translation': '首次應用於 iPhone 17 嘅 N1 無線晶片，據傳亦會用於新 Apple TV 4K。'}

{'text': 'With the N1, the new Apple TV will support Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, as well as the Thread networking protocol.', 'translation': '加入 N1 之後，新 Apple TV 將支援 Wi-Fi 7 同 Bluetooth 6，以及 Thread 網絡協定。'}

{'text': 'By comparison, the existing, now four-year-old Apple TV hardware only supports Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.', 'translation': '相比之下，現有、已經推出四年嘅 Apple TV 硬件只支援 Wi-Fi 6 同 Bluetooth 5。'}

{'text': 'What features are you hoping for in the new Apple TV 4K? Drop your thoughts in the comments.', 'translation': '你對新 Apple TV 4K 有咩功能期望？歡迎喺留言區分享你嘅想法。'}

{'text': 'Best Apple TV 4K accessories', 'translation': '最佳 Apple TV 4K 配件'}

  • {'text': 'AirPods Pro 3 (on sale for $199, originally $249)', 'translation': 'AirPods Pro 3（現價只要 199 美元，原價 249 美元）'}
  • {'text': 'Silicone protective case with grip (for Siri Remote, AirTag compatible)', 'translation': '防滑矽膠保護套（適用於 Siri Remote，兼容 AirTag）'}
  • {'text': 'TotalMount Apple TV mount', 'translation': 'TotalMount Apple TV 掛架'}
  • {'text': 'Continuous iPhone camera mount for Apple TV', 'translation': '適用於 Apple TV 嘅 iPhone 持續性相機支架'}
